name: Psionic Bull Rush [Psionic]
body:
You can use psionic energy to carry the force of a bull rush through your foe.

Prerequisite: Improved Bull Rush.

Benefit: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a bull rush combat maneuver, you also deal damage equal to half your level to the creature bull rushed.

If you expend your psionic focus when you successfully make a bull rush maneuver, you can also knock the target of your bull rush prone.
